claims.text: GDACS assessed Tropical Cyclone NOUL-26 (Kiyapo) at an Orange alert level, indicating medium humanitarian impact, for an event affecting China and the Philippines between 23 and 26 July 2026, with about 11.9 million people exposed to Category 1 or higher wind speeds.

GDACS recorded maximum sustained winds of 157 km/h (Category 2 equivalent, per JTWC data) for Tropical Cyclone NOUL-26, with a maximum storm surge of 1.6 metres occurring on 25 July 2026 at 21:00 UTC; as of 25 July the storm centre was located about 135 km east of Catanduanes, Philippines.

description: Tropical Cyclone NOUL-26 (named Kiyapo in the Philippines, Hongxia in China) tracked across the northern Philippines and the South China Sea in late July 2026 before making a second landfall in Guangdong province, southern China, around 26 July 2026. GDACS assessed an Orange alert for medium humanitarian impact, with about 11.9 million people exposed to Category 1 or higher wind speeds across the Philippines and China, maximum sustained winds of 157 km/h (Category 2 equivalent, per JTWC data), and a maximum storm surge of 1.6 metres recorded on 25 July 2026. No allowlisted authoritative source has yet published a confirmed death toll, injury count, or evacuation figure for this storm.
